title: Fleet Rung 27 — THE METRONOME AUDIT [NINETEENTH-COLLISION RENUMBER per the later-mover law: the name-proof lane landed CR-0056/feat-051/E48/v1.35.0 first (51f6b05) and the rebase three-way merge of run-evals.cjs/feature_list.json silently took their side inside this lane's own commit — the eval suite caught the loss (E32 keyless FAIL) and the rung was re-slotted on the merged tree; their suffix-law composes, it guards the keeper's registry names while this rung guards the scheduler's time]. THE FLEET MEASURES ITS OWN TIME: GitHub's scheduler stopped firing scheduled events on this repo — the last scheduled run observed anywhere was 2026-10-03T20:10:04Z; every schedule added after ~18:36Z has ZERO scheduled runs ever (fill-ledger-cron, market-grid-cron, fleet-census-cron, sovereign-tick-cron, earn-audit-cron, tick-keeper — all alive only via keeper-arc hand-dispatches), and the old 30-min grid-trigger-twin schedule degraded to sparse drops (14:32:05Z -> 18:36:46Z gap of 8 slots). A cadence the fleet cannot see is a cadence that can rot silently. The rung builds the instrument: collect (keyless) -> measure (pure deterministic desk) -> heal (bounded dispatch) -> surface (owner dashboard).

findings_and_answers: F1 · THE INVISIBLE CADENCE: the estate books held zero scheduler health data — the R27 audit had to query the Actions API by hand (43 scheduled workflows, 2 dispatch-only survivors among the young crons). ANSWER: agents/scheduler-collect.cjs (keyless I/O on the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN: cron extraction from every workflow file + the scheduled-run census per workflow, fail-soft per row, window = 24h) feeds agents/scheduler-audit.cjs (pure, deterministic, fail-soft, STASIS-braked): expected-vs-observed slots with a 40-min grace, PULSE/DEGRADED/STARVED/UNMEASURED verdict machine, the repo-wide scheduler boundary (lastScheduledAt max), and the bounded heal list. Wired as an independent leg on fleet-census-cron (the estate-audit cadence) with publish + volatile no-noise wiring.

F2 · THE MEASURED STARVATION (first book, live): verdict SCHEDULER-STARVED — 6 starved (zero scheduled runs in window while expected > 0), 15 degraded (missed >= 3), 1 unmeasured (API error — measured nothing, invented nothing), boundary 2026-10-03T20:10:04Z. Every number {cron, expected, observed, lastScheduledAt}. The platform's side cannot be fixed from here; it can now be SEEN every day, honestly.

F3 · THE SELF-HEALING FLEET IS THE KEYLESS FLEET: the heal list composes the R26 wave with the R27 instrument — heal candidates = STARVED ∧ keyless (the census's own owner-secret regex over the file) ∧ not-host ∧ not-keeper, cap 3 encoded as data. LIVE PROOF (2026-10-04T00:43Z): the desk listed earn-audit-cron.yml, fill-ledger-cron.yml, market-grid-cron.yml; scheduler-heal.cjs dispatched all three via the built-in token — HTTP 204 x3 — and GitHub registered the runs at 00:43:08-00:43:11Z. Secret-carrying starved legs (e.g. sovereign-tick-cron) are EXCLUDED by law — they stay owner/keeper territory. E49 pins the composition law fresh-process on a fixture where a starved secret-carrying workflow must be skipped.

F4 · THE R26 WAVE PROVEN IN CI (receipt booked here): audience-analyst ran at 2026-10-04T00:29:44Z on head 8d86d12 (the converted code) — SUCCESS, and the digest commit 5e4ca43 was published by the workflow itself via the built-in github.token: the first keyless CI publish of the wave. cloud-heart/soldiers-curate were audited as remaining WEAVE_OPS_PAT users and CONFIRMED genuine cross-repo (checkout steem) — the honest line from CR-0055 holds.

F5 · THE SUITE CAUGHT ITS OWN AUTHOR (twice this rung, booked honestly): (a) a scope leak — the E49 block referenced a helper defined inside an earlier eval's try-block; the ReferenceError was swallowed by an inner catch and booked as a plain FAIL until traced; (b) a window-math error (a cron slot counted outside its window). Both fixed. And the rebase merge silently took the name-proof lane's side of run-evals.cjs/feature_list.json inside this lane's own commit — the E32 keyless FAIL on the merged tree exposed it. The eval discipline is the only thing standing between a rung and a fiction.
